original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: For the pinned selected gauge44 word, group rank-one climbs into the 369 chronological same-(phase,register) triple windows. Allow at most five simultaneously live rank-three packets, hence 15 additional scalar scratch arrays; find the exact maximum interval schedule and screen the full per-call rank profile with all scratch inventory and dirty-state costs set to zero.
scope_change_reason: The unchanged eight-array, late-output interface is covered by the fixed-block moment optimum. This task changes that restriction by adding a bounded scratch inventory for staggered outputs, rather than reclassifying climbs within the proved interface.
bottleneck_link: The selected complex supplier is the binding side, and its local rank-one profile dominates the local excess cost. Even an optimistic temporal aggregation must raise the per-call packing ceiling by at least 5 percent to justify constructing a changed helper interface.
stop_rule: Exhaust the exact source-derived triple windows with scratch packet capacity K=1,3,5. Screen K=5 with zero scratch initialization, frame, dirty-state, restoration, hosting, precision, and controller costs. Stop if the exact ceiling remains below 1.05 times the selected-word ceiling; do not construct a physically incomplete route.
evidence: RESULT.json pins the 369 candidate intervals. Exact integral time-line flow selects at most 85 triples with K=5 (15 arrays), yielding profile {1:2157,2:418,3:517,4:142,5:82,8:8}. With all scratch costs omitted, the exact ceiling bracket is [107/62500,1713/1000000], below the 5 percent target 35491136290869/20000000000000000. Exhaustive small interval controls validate the maximum-cardinality flow model.

triage.result: Even deleting 48 rank-one children at zero cost gives a packing ceiling of 0.001706 on the 1e-6 grid, less than a 5 percent gain over the selected-word ceiling; not pursued.

no_open_questions_reason: The exact favorable ceiling already rejects the declared K<=5 inventory before construction. Work with more than 15 scratch arrays changes this capped mechanism and needs a separately justified seed and screen.
